notes.title: 0.5.0 QoL, Sorting, Automation, Increasing Rarity
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Added mechanics for increasing the rarity of items. You can increase rarity when processing minerals in the <Improve> submenu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hero build menu that allows you to automate the leveling of skills, perks, characteristics, and weapon techniques. Feature opens after 5 rituals. For those who already have 5 or more rituals, 1 more rebirth ritual is required.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an auto potion menu that allows you to set potions to be used automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]Added automation for summoning minions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notation switch in the options.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an <Tweaks> submenu in the options, which allows you to customize various aspects of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added inventory sorting.[/p][/*][*][p]The rarity of items in the store corresponds to your progress in the game and can reach 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted boss behavior so that they cannot be taken outside the zone.[/p][/*][*][p]You can smoke Ledum to reset all nodes in the Threads of Fate and redistribute them.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the effect of knot 2 of the Pilgrim thread.[/p][/*][*][p]Chaos bones are now reset to the required amount after the ritual so that health does not go into the negative.[/p][/*][*][p]The effect of the Chop technique for bosses and possessed characters has been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-clicks can now collect loot upon contact with it.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot will be collected automatically if there is more than 100 pieces on the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Items in the inventory can be added to favorites. To do this, click on the heart in the right corner of the cell.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto Blacksmith has been improved. The number of levels that can be raised is tied to the maximum possible level increase for the item with the available gold.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when switching between x1/x10/x100/MAX modes, the amount of gold next to the weapon will be displayed, which is how much will be spent on raising the level.[/p][/*][*][p]The Auto Blacksmith sound has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Bats no longer drop eggs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the damage of the ghost pickaxe, summoned through the genius in the Threads of Fate.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the limit from the gift chest scale in the alchemist's shop.[/p][/*][*][p]<Craft Points> and <Skill Points> in the store have been changed to the <Skill Points> bonus.
The <Skill Points> bonus adds one point per hero level to both combat skills and crafts. 
A limit of 10 levels has been set for improving this bonus.
The price of upgrading <Skill Points> in the Alchemist's Shop has been increased.
For players who have upgraded beyond the limit, the bonus will be reduced to the limit, and the spent Ledum and Mercury will be returned.[/p][p][i]We made this decision in order to balance the Combat and Crafting branches.
The previous division tilted the game too much towards crafting.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where runes were not displayed when opening the Chaos Chest.[/p][/*][*][p]God phenomena will be available after the first island storyline to achieve the achievement.(if for some reason it was not received)[/p][/*][*][p]Changed explanation for transmutation.[/p][/*][*][p]The animation of the Wave has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]The formula for the rune technique Reduce Mana Cost has been changed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.4.1
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Gaze of destiny points were awarded not only for completing an island, but also for completing a location. Knots have been reset, points should be redistributed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added mechanics for moving between explored islands.[/p][/*][*][p]Rings now have symbols.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a note to the wizardy window stating that the <Poeta> sigil interferes with summoning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game crash related to skill improvement.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.4.0 Threads of destiny
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/f90abb60d481838b8f13a1372eda63677b43cdce.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Threads of destiny[/b][/p][p][i]Living souls are bound by a pair of thick, knotted threads of fate and several thin ones; only astral beings or the dead are not bound by any. By sailing across the ocean, you follow the path of the gods, and they turn their gaze upon you.[/i][/p][p]The new mechanics will expand hero's existing functionality and make your playthrough more effective. Tie a knot on the thread you are interested in and get a talent or genius that will make you much stronger.[/p][p][/p][p]Other changes in the game:[/p][list][*][p]In the cursor settings, you can select System cursor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Chop it up  technique worked on every hit instead of every 10 hits. Fixed that this technique reduces half of the current health instead of the maximum health. This technique will now not work if the enemy has less than 1% health remaining.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where fire streams could move backward indefinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some rune characteristics were not reset upon rebirth.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game would crash after the death of allied skeleton mages.[/p][/*][*][p]Reducing mana cost by 100% now brings the cost to 0 (i.e., free to use) instead of retaining 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon techniques can now be upgraded by 10 if you hold down Shift or click the Right mouse button. If you hold down Control, all points will be invested in the specified technique.[/p][/*][*][p]A setting has been added to automatically leave the bonfire, which determines when the timer should start when certain characteristics are filled.[/p][/*][*][p]The Chaos Bones setting is now available at the bonfire.[/p][/*][*][p]A blocking mode has been added for quick slots, which will not allow them to be upgraded for gold. It can be enabled by clicking the x1/x10/x100/Max/Blocked button.[/p][/*][*][p]A <Use bow in battle> mode has been added for bows in the quick slot. When this mode is disabled, the hero will only use the bow for hunting, even if they do not have a melee weapon.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Notes: Skills
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Illegal Turtle team here.

The development of the game is in full swing, and in the meantime we would like to tell you about the hero skills in the game Gothic Clicker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/c957e664ed2d2d0b5bb9d9d099aa37e87679f0f5.gif[/img]
There are 2 skill branches in the game - Combat Skills and Crafts.
Each branch contains 5 skills.
Each skill has 6 perks, which can be changed later.

[b]Combat Skills[/b]

[u]Close combat[/u] - increases the damage of swords, axes and maces. Good for active play, when you keep an eye on your opponents and calculate your stamina wisely.
[i]Bonuses: melee damage increase, stamina increase.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/35142b262d82124106cc9ef76069068d8d14086f.gif[/img]

[u]Shooting[/u] is the main skill for archers. Thanks to shooting you can easily keep enemies at a distance and kill them before they even try to do something. Good for semi-passive play, as a little control over combat is still retained.
[i]Bonuses: increased damage when shooting, increased stamina.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/f044d76c66e0beba78d5e3a50ccf446b78eaa534.gif[/img]

[u]Magic[/u] is a versatile combat skill. With it you can boost active actions, such as clicks, or focus on passive play and just increase magic damage. The price of the boosts is mana. It will take a flexible approach to use this skill in an appropriate way. Also, this skill is required to work with runes.
[i]Bonuses: increase elemental damage, increase mana, increase mana regeneration.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/193e9381c96456b317bed1f77bc33adfef1d4270.gif[/img]

[u]Defense[/u] - increases your survivability. Good for melee warriors, but mages will also benefit from the health boost. Especially good for playing with a shield.
[i]Bonuses: armor class increase, health increase, stamina increase.[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/98bf83245fcd552ffdb0c53ac3ecb6b393281671.gif[/img]

[u]Wizardry[/u] - why fight when others can? Organizing a small squad can be done with no problem if you have enough spirit. A great skill for a completely passive game.
[i]Bonuses: increased arcana of invocation, increased minion power, increased spirit.[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/6ee171d480f251e30eb518374ecc7b2a714acc30.gif[/img]

[b]Crafts[/b]

[u]Hunting[/u] - if there is a need for gold or you need to heal quickly, it is worth paying attention to this skill. It allows you to earn a decent fortune and stay in battle as long as possible at the expense of trophies.
[i]Bonuses: increased gold from trophies, increased chance to get trophies from game.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/88e89b90f3428235088b221ae760a881ddc49920.gif[/img]

[u]Mining[/u] is an essential skill for the long game. At the expense of minerals, you can make your weapon legendary, and your character - a real hero.
[i]Bonuses: increased power of mineral search, increased stamina.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/460d89a6041877961ccf64d20b20368d2e60f6d8.gif[/img]

[u]Herbalism[/u] is a skill for efficient plant gathering. Build up your tactical advantage by brewing a large number of potions, or your strategic advantage by utilizing the natural powers of herbs.
[i]Herbalism[/i]: increased potion level, increased plant search.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/4369ea173a2957e6d630f2c73cf2f74919eec7cc.gif[/img]

[u]Cunning[/u] is not only a skill for getting the most gold possible, but also for those who like to take the enemy by surprise. Can you survive in a cruel world without cunning, where meanness is the weapon of your enemies?
[i]Bonuses: increase gold flow, increase the power of tricks.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/9d085bddc28915b034b60e19e57371fc6eb1bc19.gif[/img]

[u]Prayer[/u] - faith in the gods will not go unrewarded. 
By performing prayers at the altars, you receive blessings that grant you a piece of divine powers. The stronger the faith, the easier the path.
[i]Bonuses: increased spirit, increased duration of blessings, increased number of blessings.[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/e11749735156aa46e26b5c9581b9177de8849c77.gif[/img]

That's all for today. Wait for the next news, there are many more interesting things ahead of you!
Like the news if you like it and go to our Discord channel:
https://discord.com/invite/rnCStXCNmS

notes.title: Dev Notes: Weapons
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone, this is the Illegal Turtle team here![/b]
Gothic Clicker is coming out on August 22nd, and in order not to waste any time, we decided to release “developer notes” in the form of articles so that you can familiarize yourself with some of the features and lore before the release.
We will try to post interesting articles after each development cycle.
Join our new community in Discord to follow the project and help in its creation:
https://discord.gg/rnCStXCNmS

[h3]Our first article is dedicated to [b]WEAPONS[/b].[/h3]

[u]The game will have the following types of weapons:[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/83583f33751b3d11760bc59de884c56c21b6a106.png[/img][b]Swords[/b] - balanced weapons. Moderately strong and fast. For those who like stability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/683443ead15dbb2c951dc532b35b970ae39605c7.png[/img][b]Maces [/b]- heavy weapons. Slow attacks, but crushing. A competent approach will allow you to win in 1 blow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/f3941b99c819f9b5cc98b84c08725b35944b101c.png[/img][b]Axes [/b]- a weapon for active players who like to click. Speed is slightly lower than swords, and damage is slightly higher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/d73853aa933620dcdd9a2db6e4d12c989cce9af0.png[/img][b]Bows[/b] are the weapon of hunters. Allows you to effectively hunt game and kill enemies at a distance, before they even reach you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/3841e260c0fea7e742dbebb92db4af397ec07b22.png[/img][b]Shields [/b]- protects against enemy damage and can complement weapons. Some mages will also do well with a shield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/d6a9071d15a213ead3f758b5b9320d231d29bff9.png[/img][b]Runes [/b]- a magical weapon that works independently and does not require the attention of your hero. Very effective, but requires the appropriate skills.

Melee weapons are one-handed and two-handed. 
One-handed weapons can also be combined with other one-handed weapons, or with a shield. 
In total in the game (at the moment) more than 100 types of different weapons. 
Each weapon has its own original name, appearance, set of characteristics and techniques. 

[h3]Techniques[/h3]
Each weapon has two techniques.
Techniques are special abilities that are inherent to the selected weapon.
Below we can see Guard using “Geyser” technique with the hammer, and militiaman using Starfall technique with a bow.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/32b09b852763b859764715175c683cc25c63077d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/3f0233b0ab14d1845a1115edda4173f4b411ea48.gif[/img]
There are magic techniques like this!
There are also quite classic techniques (“Powerful blow”, “Blow with a swing”).
Some of the techniques support active play when you want to click more (“Angry strike”, “Aiming”).
There are also those aimed at the idle side of the game. For example, the “auto-hunt” technique on some bows, which allows you to hunt automatically.

[h3]Ore Processing[/h3]

You have the Philosopher's Stone, a magical artifact that allows you to upgrade your weapons for gold right during combat and pump up your techniques. But gold alone will not be enough to increase the effectiveness of your weapons by an order of magnitude.
The best way to increase the quality of your weapons is by processing ore, but you'll need a variety of minerals, that you encounter along the way. The experience of an ore miner from a previous life will help you figure out what's what!
You can also dismantle weapons you already have for minerals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/0baeebf872e27e61f3c8f572a628b86630db09e7.gif[/img]
You can also spend minerals to create spheres.
Spheres are inserted into free slots and give the item magical properties.
We can say that spheres are universal techniques that can be used to enchant any weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/95fb649255cd03334c5f60c28927c7cf2d8a4c15.gif[/img]

We will probably stop here.
Like this post if you found it interesting and follow Gothic Clicker so you don't miss out on new posts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352025/08b891ce60abb17b890444ab4bd986445920c979.png[/img]
In the next article we will tell you about the history of the world of the game, and what the hero will face on his difficult path in the kingdom of Elderath.
